description:
A mass-produced Nikke from the Melee Squad.
The numerous modifications she has undergone mean that her physical capabilities are far superior to those of a typical mass-produced Nikke.
Known as a swordsmanship genius, possessing extraordinary skills.

costumes.name: Longing Flower
costumes.description:
Scarlet: Black Shadow costume.
Obtained from the Costume Gacha.

lines.text:
Nothing is eternal.
That is the only unchanging truth in this world.

Thou should not get too close,
lest by some mischance I hurt thee.
Thou art most welcome to spar with me at any time.

Fleeting as time may be,
I cannot see an end in sight for me.

The Goddess Squad has many capable hands.
'Tis its most preeminent aspect.

I shall become stronger and not be at the mercy of anyone.
Failure is not an option.

Follow the wind... the clouds... and your heart...
Heh-heh, 'tis but impossible.

There are many things to fight for in this vast world.
Rose, is it also a way to progress through this life?

Where is Lilith?
I crave a good tussle.

I am in search of a place to train.
Pray tell, dost thou have anything in mind?

Where does my heart take me...?
I desire to go where the strongest personalities congregate.

I am a sword which renders Raptures asunder.
Do not wield me capriciously, for even my handle has a sharp edge.
I desire to be strong enough to cleave anything in half.
Now I can fell stronger opponents!
Fleetly Fading is more honed than ever.

Thank you so much,
this is precisely what I require.

This gift... is out of sheer goodwill?
Can such a notion truly exist in this world?

Thanks.
Let me know if you need anything in return.

Please, keep thy distance.
No good will come of us getting too close.

Should you desire for something to be cleaved in half,
I am at your command.
Someone who is this close to me... apart from Rose?
I consider it a blessing to fight alongside you. Let us be on our way.
Tell me what you want.
Let's go.
A fight then, is it?
I will destroy everything that's in my way.
Whew... have at you.
If only there were a worthy opponent.
You're a rather tenacious foe.
Need a sharper sword...
I'm on my way.
I'm ready.
Fleetly Fading, strike!
Mine blade shall render all asunder.
Next.
But a mere bagatelle.
Is that all?
Wha...?
Ugh.
Ow!
Ha-ha... This is not what I expected...
A commendable battle, but I desire stronger opponents next time.
How dost thou expect me to do battle in this garb?

Far too frilly and bothersome. 
Methinks mine own attire shall be sliced before the foe.
Such attire is more befitting of Dorothy.

'Tis encouraging to hear that these threads suit me,
but I would rather consign them to a fate in storage rather than being worn.

While I am not well-versed in the rest, I must say the pattern on these garments doth please me greatly.
... These flowers stir a most nostalgic longing within me.

Even fully bloomed flowers will eventually wilt,
but the florets on these clothes will spring eternal.

So great is the discomfort of these clothes, that my body feels sluggish. 
I should move around a little.

I do know someone who would wear these garments with greater aplomb than I.
I'm sure they would be delighted to wear them.

Even perambulating is torturous.
I am being forced to walk slowly.
Pray tell, where might the others be? I must observe how striking and cumbersome their garments appear.
It appears there's naught worth cutting.
Not even the most embellished scabbard can hide the sharpness of my blade.

Mine strength is still lacking.
I must become stronger.
I've learned a lesson.
Mine blade hath grown keener.
Thank you. I will put it to good use.

I am unsure as to why thou art bequeathing this unto me.
I am not accustomed to receiving gifts.

Are you truly bestowing this upon me?
Very well, I shall accept it for now.
Keep away and let not the luxurious exterior beguile you; 'tis but a mere scabbard that holds a sword within.
I did not don these garments merely for appearances, but to see you so joyous is most pleasing.

Grip the hilt. And should there be aught to cleave, let it be struck with resolve.
I shall be thy sword.
I want to change mine attire.
Speak.
So uncomfortable...
At last, I can stretch mine body.
Despite the accursed garments, I'm able to slice a Rapture.
... This brings to mind when I fought beside my sister.
I shall cleave through them all.
This attire vexes me.
It seems this battle shall drag on.
I shall go again.
'Tis time for the flower to bloom.
Will thou come view the flowers?
One stroke, and thou are cleaved through.
How disappointing.
Next.
Bisect.
Not bad.
Ugh...
Agh.
Had it not been for these garments, I could have fought with far greater fervor.

'Tis taken me longer than usual.
Had I donned mine usual garb, I would have been swifter.
